newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products up $2, mogas barges trade $198.50.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products up $2, mogas barges trade $198.50.

text.p: NWE oil products climbed $2 a tonne in early trading on Friday.
Gasoline traded at $198.50 on Rotterdam barges but May swaps were offered later at $197.50with June $3.50 lower.
Fuel barges were little changed from late Thursday levels at $82 but swaps firmed $2 a tonne in brisk trading. May barges traded up to $84.50 before sellers offered back down to $84.
Gas oil barges were $2 a tonne higher with the IPE but there was little in premiums against the screen.
